_readme: Canonical registry of commentators/authors appearing anywhere in data, derived from data/taxonomy.json's _default_author fields plus a small set of authors recovered from tika_ key-naming conventions where the _default_author field itself was corrupted (see PENDING.md for the corruption writeup). 'traditions' are taxonomy top-branch tags (dvaita/advaita/vishishtadvaita/etc), not a claim of exhaustive scholarly classification. 'note' flags an identification that is inferred (e.g. from title-pattern matching) rather than independently confirmed -- treat as a lead, not a citation, until verified against a real source.

anandatirthacharya.name: Anandatirthacharya
anandatirthacharya.note: son of Mudgalarya; NOT Madhvacharya, a distinct later acharya sharing the epithet

apaurusheya.name: Apaurusheya
apaurusheya.note: traditionally unauthored / eternally revealed; rishi per mantra may be noted in the item's own 'rishi' field

sripadaraja.name: Sri Sripadaraja
sripadaraja.note: vāgvajraḥ's author is recorded as "श्रीपादराजगुरुसार्वभौमः" (Sripadaraja Guru Sarvabhauma) -- the honorific by which Sripadaraja is traditionally known; identified with this entry on that basis, not an independently confirmed source

traditionally_revealed_divya_prabandha_o.name: Traditionally revealed (Divya Prabandha of Bhagavan Narayana); human compiler varies by samhita and is often unrecorded

vyasatattvajna.name: Vyasatattvajna
vyasatattvajna.note: identity uncertain -- possibly an epithet for Sri Vyasatirtha; flagged for verification
